sloka: स्वयेव प्रभया मेरुमुदये विमलो रविः ।तेन विभ्राजता तत्र सा सभाभिव्यरोचत ॥२-३-३६॥
transliteration: svayeva prabhayā merumudaye vimalo raviḥ ।tena vibhrājatā tatra sā sabhābhivyarocata ॥2-3-36॥

translations.english: ﻿ That assembly was illumined by (the presence of) Rama like the Moon dazzling the clear autumnal sky bespangled with sparkling planets and stars.
